sec.t: ff.135.1 It's all a casino: manipulation
sec.p: We have a problem: Trump. Or rather, the possibility that the world changes with a tweet; for a war, a tariff hike, a migration ban.
We can no longer afford to centralise information and decisions (badly): the archive fire in South Korea that burned 8 years of public work.
The distrust of “single nodes” (and of America) is all in this chart, which shows that for the first time since 1996 central banks are buying more gold than US public debt:
Back to the debt of the United States of America. And to cryptocurrencies.
